en.title: Choosing a Markdown editor for Mac
en.description: What to check in a Mac Markdown editor: plain files, WYSIWYG or split preview, math, sync and speed, with Typora, Obsidian, VS Code and MiaoYan compared.

zh.title: Mac 上怎么选 Markdown 编辑器
zh.description: 从纯文件、所见即所得、公式图表、同步和性能几方面比较 Typora、Obsidian、VS Code 与妙言。

en.title: Markdown cheat sheet: CommonMark, GFM and extensions
en.description: The Markdown syntax you actually use, with examples, what CommonMark and GFM each define, and what MiaoYan renders on top.

zh.title: Markdown 语法速查与 GFM 差异
zh.description: 常用 Markdown 语法加示例，区分 CommonMark、GFM 与应用扩展，并说明妙言实际能渲染什么。

en.title: LaTeX math in Markdown: syntax, KaTeX and pitfalls
en.description: Write inline and block math in Markdown, use common LaTeX constructs, avoid dollar and underscore pitfalls, and see how MiaoYan renders KaTeX.

zh.title: Markdown 里写 LaTeX 公式
zh.description: 行内与块级公式的写法、常用 LaTeX 结构、美元符号和下划线的坑，以及妙言如何用 KaTeX 渲染。

en.title: Mermaid diagrams in Markdown: flowchart, sequence, Gantt
en.description: Draw flowcharts, sequence and Gantt diagrams with fenced Mermaid blocks, plus PlantUML and Markmap, and what MiaoYan renders offline.

zh.title: Markdown 里画 Mermaid 图
zh.description: 用围栏代码块画流程图、时序图和甘特图，对比 PlantUML 与 Markmap，并说明妙言哪些图离线可用。

en.title: Markdown to slides: --- separators and MiaoYan PPT mode
en.description: Turn a Markdown note into a slide deck with --- separators, configure reveal.js options, and compare Marp, reveal.js and Slidev.

zh.title: Markdown 转幻灯片：用 --- 分页
zh.description: 用 --- 把笔记分成幻灯片，配置 reveal.js 选项，并比较妙言 PPT 模式与 Marp、Slidev。

en.title: Typora alternative for Mac: split preview with MiaoYan
en.description: Why people leave Typora, WYSIWYG versus split preview, what carries over (files, math, images) and where each app is stronger.

zh.title: Mac 上的 Typora 替代品
zh.description: 为什么有人离开 Typora，所见即所得与分栏预览的取舍，笔记、公式和图片能带走什么，以及两者各自强在哪里。

en.title: Local-first Markdown notes: keep them as plain files
en.description: Why plain Markdown files in your own folder beat a locked-in notes app, what it costs, and how MiaoYan reads the folder you choose.

zh.title: 本地优先的 Markdown 笔记怎么管
zh.description: 为什么把笔记存成自己文件夹里的纯 Markdown 文件，要付出什么，以及妙言怎么读取你选的文件夹。

en.title: Sync Markdown notes across devices without a sync service
en.description: Use iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox or git to sync a Markdown notes folder, set MiaoYan's Note Location, and avoid conflict copies.

zh.title: 跨设备同步 Markdown 笔记的几种做法
zh.description: 用 iCloud 云盘、坚果云、Dropbox 或 git 同步笔记文件夹，在妙言里设置笔记位置，并避开冲突副本。

en.title: Wikilinks and backlinks in Markdown notes
en.description: How [[wikilinks]] differ from normal Markdown links, what MiaoYan supports, how backlinks are built, and the portability trade-offs.

zh.title: Markdown 笔记里的 Wikilink 与反向链接
zh.description: [[wikilink]] 和普通 Markdown 链接有什么不同，妙言支持什么，反向链接怎么生成，可移植性上要付出什么。

en.title: Markdown notes from the terminal with the miao CLI
en.description: Install the miao CLI, learn open, new, search, list and cat, script them, and use them with AI coding agents and the MiaoYan skill.

zh.title: 在终端里使用 Markdown 笔记：miao 命令行
zh.description: 安装 miao，掌握 open、new、search、list、cat，写脚本，并配合 AI 编码 Agent 和妙言 skill 使用。

en.title: A lighter Obsidian alternative for Mac
en.description: What MiaoYan has and leaves out compared with Obsidian, how to open a vault, and which syntax carries over.

zh.title: Mac 上更轻的 Obsidian 替代品
zh.description: 妙言和 Obsidian 相比有什么、没有什么，怎么打开 vault，以及哪些语法能带过来。

en.title: Markdown note version history: MiaoYan, Time Machine, git
en.description: How MiaoYan saves and restores note versions, where they live, their limits, and how Time Machine and git cover what it does not.

zh.title: Markdown 笔记的版本历史怎么用
zh.description: 妙言如何保存和恢复笔记版本、存在哪里、有什么限制，以及 Time Machine 和 git 怎么补上它覆盖不到的部分。
